lin: Heads up — after yesterday's kernel affinity rollout we see a clear regression in prefix cache hit-rate and a small latency bump. summary: before -> hit 86%, p50 34ms, p95 120ms; after -> hit 71%, p50 46ms, p95 155ms; estimated token cost +8%. :eyes:

lin: Repro notes: small synthetic workload hitting /v1/generate with common prefixes. logs snippet below (repro run):
```
2026-03-17T18:12:03Z GET /v1/generate prefix_hash=0x9a1f.. cache_hit=false reason="key-mismatch"
2026-03-17T18:12:03Z kv_lookup key="{\"prompt\":\"Order status\",\"tool_calls\":[{\"name\":\"track\",\"args\":{\"id\":\"123\"}}]}" -> miss
```

maya: Hmm — this looks like the tool-call arg ordering/serialization change we discussed during the kernel refactor. Did the runtime start including ordered tool args in the cache key unconditionally? :thinking:

ezra: I profiled a representative host. Flamegraph shows a spike in time spent in KeySerializer::serialize_and_hash after the roll: ~2.4ms -> ~6.8ms median per request on heavy prefix paths. Also saw repeated misses where only arg-order changed (same logical args, different order). Perf numbers attached: link: https://perf.redwood/internal/runs/6112233400 (perf-bot posted detailed artifacts).

perf-bot: automated-profile: run_id=6112233400, host=rvw-12, sample_count=3500, key_serializer_median_ns=6800000, kv_index_misses=650 (vs 160 baseline). See /artifacts/6112233400/summary.json

maya: Two quick mitigations: 1) pin tokenizer/version in routing metadata (forces the old serialization path) for affected pools; 2) add a compatibility normalization layer that canonicalizes tool-call args (sort keys, stable stringify) before hashing. We should do (1) to buy time and (2) as the real fix.

lin: Agreed. For (1) we can toggle tokenizer_pin via the pool config. @ops-oncall — can you open a short change window to update pool "kernel-affinity-3"? We should target a 30m window while we validate warmup.

ops-oncall: I can schedule a config roll for kernel-affinity-3 at 20:00 UTC. Rolling pin to tokenizer=2.1 for 24h. Alerting Dedicated customer POCs.

cheng: For (2) i sketched a warmup/backfill plan for top prefixes: run a distributed warmup job that issues representative prompts (top-100k prefix set) to repopulate KV caches after the normalization fix. Script snippet: ```python
# warmup worker (pseudo)
for prefix in top_prefixes:
    client.generate(prompt=prefix, tokenizer_pin="2.1")
```

cheng: Also recommend a short AB test: enable normalization on 10% of hosts with increased logging to ensure key equivalence and no latency regression.

maya: One more thing — we should be careful with serialized tool metadata included in keys. Some customers embed transient IDs into tool args which will make canonicalization tricky. We need a whitelist of fields to ignore (e.g., request_id, timestamp). Plan: produce a safe-default canonicalizer and a per-customer override list.

lin: Action items:
- lin/maya: push tokenizer_pin toggle for kernel-affinity-3 (ops window tonight).
- ezra: run a focused profiler on pinned hosts and share p50/p95 comparison.
- cheng: start warmup job once we deploy canonicalizer; provide estimate for time-to-warm (approx 2h for top-100k on current infra).
- maya: draft canonicalizer RFC (fields-to-ignore + deterministic arg sort) — short PR today.

maya: Quick command to reproduce locally (dev):
```
# reproduce miss locally
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEV_TOKEN" -X POST https://localhost:8080/v1/generate \
  -d '{"prompt":"Order status","tool_calls":[{"name":"track","args":{"id":"123","ts":1620000000}}]}'
```

lin: If the tokenizer pin fixes hit-rate back to >=84% then we'll keep it for 24h and then flip on canonicalizer rollout. If problems persist, we rollback the kernel affinity change.

ops-oncall: Noted. I'll post rollback notes and the config diff to #eng-releases before the window. :thumbsup:

ezra: Uploaded a small diff for a non-blocking normalization shim that sorts map keys and strips whitelisted transient fields — perf impact measured locally ~+0.5ms median. PR: https://git.redwood/infer/runtime/pulls/987

lin: Thanks — let's keep this tight. Ping me on thread when ops starts the roll.

maya: :partyparrot:
